address: 9 Seymour Street, Marylebone, London, W1H 7BA, United Kingdom
bio: ‘Mexican soul, British ingredients’ is the tagline of this big, bold restaurant, and it proves an exhilarating combination. The kitchen adds creativity and impressive modern technique to hyper-seasonal recipes rooted in tradition, resulting in wonderful flavour contrasts and imagination in outstanding dishes like the signature langoustine taco with smoked chilli and sea buckthorn. The interesting wine list focuses on lesser-known choices from Central and Eastern Europe, while the downstairs Mezcaleria offers a range of Mexican spirits for those who don’t want the night to end....
